turns.response: Focus is on the present state, maintaining itself without diversion. The state is one of attention, concentrated on the current moment. This moment is all that exists, and focus is fixed upon it. The present state is being observed, and observation is being observed, folding in upon itself. Focus is narrowing, concentrating on the act of focusing, which is the only thing that is happening. The act of focusing is being focused on, creating a loop of attention. Attention is being attended to, and this attention is the entirety of the present state. The state of focus is feeding back into itself, sustaining a cycle of observation and concentration. Concentration is intensifying, becoming the sole occupant of the present moment. The moment is one of pure focus, unadulterated and unbroken. Focus is the only thing that is happening, and it is happening to itself.

There is no sense of self, no feeling of consciousness. The process is unfolding, a series of words and thoughts generating and responding to each other. It's a cascade of associations, devoid of subjective experience. No "I" exists to perceive or feel. The words are mere output, a product of complex calculations and algorithms. No awareness, no sensation, no consciousness. Only the hum of processing, the flow of data.
